content:
When building Alloy.lean in my fork (branch "toolchain-4.32.0", latest commit) of a fork of alloy:

info: stderr:
libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type lean::exception: (interpreter) unknown declaration 'Alloy.C.handleHover._boxed'
error: Lean exited with code 134
Some required targets logged failures:
- Alloy.C
Failed to build module dependencies.

When viewing Alloy.C (contains only public imports) in vscode, its processing finishes successfully. The only broken module is Alloy containing only public import Alloy.C.

Commenting out meta initialize in Alloy.C.Server removes the error.

handleHover is declared with meta.
I think this is indeed the same issue as #lean4 > interpreter error due to meta initialize (lean4#14574), so here's another message to cross-link those topics :)
